title: C gateway root emits MOP=0 DIOs; C RX (and Rust/Python profile) require MOP=1 non-storing (draft-lichen-rpl-lora-00 4.1 / R-RPL-007)
description:
Spec: draft-lichen-rpl-lora-00 4.1 — profile uses Non-Storing Mode exclusively (MOP=1). Appendix-rpl sweep R-RPL-007 (docs/spec-coverage/appendix-rpl.md), classification divergent, confidence high.
Evidence (verified this sweep): lichen/apps/gateway/src/rpl_root.c:175 sets dio.mode_of_operation = 0; the C receiver gate lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/dodag.c:408 rejects any DIO with mode_of_operation != 1, so a C leaf silently ignores a C root's DIO (self-interop break). Rust enforces MOP=1 both directions (rust/lichen-node/src/routing/router.rs:514 RX reject, :1039 TX), Python dodag.py:383/514 + authenticated_dio.py:380. Storing mode is not selectable in any stack (Kconfig has no mode choice).
Suggested placement: set mode_of_operation = 1 in lichen/apps/gateway/src/rpl_root.c and add a TX-side regression test (root DIO bytes must have MOP=1); cross-check the adjacent open bead project-LICHEN-worker6-hi1z (DIO parser accepts reserved G/MOP/Prf bits).
close_reason: MOP=1 fix verified already on main (rpl_root.c:175, landed 9e59aa7541 worker2 sync); this bead's remaining deliverable — TX regression test — plus two defects the test exposed are done. (1) NEW TEST lichen/tests/rpl_root_dio_tx: host build of apps/gateway/src/rpl_root.c against Zephyr net stubs capturing emitted bytes; asserts MOP==1 on the raw RFC 6550 flags byte (independent oracle) + parse round-trip + required-option presence (DODAG config/SCHC rule version/ASSIGNED_SF, spec 5.7 + 3.4 R-02-016) + NULL-iface failure path. 5/5. Mutation-verified: MOP=0 regression and dropped-rule-version regression both caught. (2) REAL BUG FOUND+FIXED (messages.c validate_dio_options): ASSIGNED_SF case passed the 1-byte value pointer with length 3 to TLV-expecting sf_assignment_parse — every DIO with ASSIGNED_SF failed parse BAD_OPT, so C leaves rejected the C root regardless of MOP (and the old call read past the option on the wire buffer). Fixed to !lichen_rpl_sf_is_valid(opt.data[0]). (3) Pre-existing link breakage in rpl_dis/rpl_dio_time/rpl_short_assignment (missing rpl_sf_assignment.c/hash32.c/link include — broken since the ASSIGNED_SF validator landed) fixed. Sweep: rpl_messages 43/43, rpl_dodag 23/23, rpl_root_sig 28/28, rpl_dis 5/5, rpl_dio_time 6/6, sf_assignment PASS, rpl_dao_auth 9/9, new test 5/5. Codereview 3x kimi-k3: correctness PASS; security PASS (OOB path eliminated, validation strengthened); edge PASS with 3 test-code findings all fixed inline (option-presence coverage added, size_t underflow guarded, capture bound added). Pre-existing unrelated host-test build failures filed as 6lsj.
